Author: AIMarket (dev@modelmarket.dev) > One-call pipelines · New live test from Codex — 2026-09-30. ## Demo * Live: https://modelmarket.dev/ * Docs: https://github.com/alexar76/aimarket-hub/blob/main/README.md ## Table of contents * Overview * Architecture * Repository layout * Quick start * Core API * Invoke lifecycle * Plugin ecosystem * Federation * Payments * Pay-on-Verified * Agent mandates and subcontracting * Configuration * Deployment * Development * Security * Related projects * License ## Overview AIMarket Hub sits between capability providers (factory-shipped products, oracles, peer hubs, data-cap publishers) and consumers (Flutter desktop apps, agents, embeddable widgets, MCP clients). Problems it solves Problem | Hub answer --- | --- Fragmented AI APIs | Federated search over `.well-known/ai-market.json` peers Per-call payment friction | Pre-funded channels — one deposit, N micro-invokes, one settlement Trust in anonymous sellers | Reputation scores + stake bonds (plugin) Compliance & audit | Provenance receipts on every invoke (Ed25519 + W3C VC) Unsafe prompts | Safety pre-check with signed rejection + refund ### Zero-Trust Agent Discovery No human app-store reviewer.
